about: Who called the plays (offense: off, defense: def) by week range (a season's regular-season weeks: 1-17 to 2020, 1-18 from 2021; the current season to date, its last range open to week 18). Head coaches who called their own side are listed as its play-caller. unverified: shared or not confirmed; left out of the coach matching (coaches.py play_callers).
